Name: Sweet And Tart
Author: Sofie77
Description:
Adds four new bush crop seasons (one per season), the fruits of which can then be made into seeds and grown as crops on your farm. I am hoping to add some cooking recipes in the future as well. This is my first mod and any constructive criticism / tips on how to improve it would be appreciated. Code for buying seeds has been added, but I'm not sure it works.

The fruits included are:
[list]
[*] Wineberry - available to gather Spring 23-25[/*]
[*] Goumi - available to gather Summer 10-13[/*]
[*] Akebi - available to gather Fall 12-15[/*]
[*] Honeyberry - available to gather Winter 25-28[/*]
[/list]
